name: NEC Stipend And Book Grant Scheme
benefit: - The selection of the students will mainly depend upon their academic performance and the need for the scholarship. - The selected students will receive stipends and book grants for studies in India only.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Nagaland State. 1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Tribe (ST) or General category. 1. The applicant should have secured a minimum of 60% marks in the last qualifying examination if belonging to the ST category. 1. The applicant should have secured a minimum of 75% marks in the last qualifying examination if belonging to the General category. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a Higher Professional course approved by the North Eastern Council (NEC).
